_readme: Run-level settings for one valuation cycle. mode = 'synthetic' generates the practice book and validates the model; mode = 'production' reads source extracts through config/source_mapping.json (the synthetic generators and the synthetic-only validation steps are skipped) and refuses to run on an assumption set that is not approved in config/assumption_approvals.json. In production these values come from the scheduler (Databricks Workflow job parameters).
